en.question: An overnight job classifies 2 million documents. Accuracy must stay above 95%, results are needed by morning, and cost is the binding constraint. What is the best configuration?

options.text: Smallest model clearing 95% on a labelled sample, run through Batch at temperature 0.
Frontier model on the real-time Messages API, run at maximum concurrency.
options.note: Real-time premium pricing for work that has an overnight window.

options.text: Frontier model with extended thinking enabled to maximise classification accuracy.
options.note: Multiplies tokens and latency for a task needing no deep reasoning.

options.text: Mid-tier model with a five-vote majority taken independently for each document.
options.note: Roughly five times the cost to fix a problem not shown to exist.

en.explanation: Every constraint points the same way: nobody is waiting, so Batch halves the cost; classification is deterministic work; and the accuracy floor is a measurable bar the cheapest qualifying model should clear.
